caption: The drawing depicts a decorative wooden mirror frame with a rectangular central mirror. The frame is elaborately carved, featuring a large fan-shaped element at the top with radiating grooves. The sides and bottom of the frame have curved, scroll-like patterns and are accented with carved floral motifs. The frame has a shelf at the bottom, extending outward, appearing weathered with visible wood grain and various natural imperfections. The coloration of the frame includes tones of yellow, brown, and hints of green, giving a rich, aged wood appearance. The background is plain and light-colored, creating contrast and highlighting the details of the frame. At the lower right corner of the image, there is a small signature with names indicated.
title: Stand for Missal
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
